answer_1.quote: After training, our model is able to produce complete paths given input step libraries ... we implement step‑level constraint beam‑decoding to sample multiple generated step sequences and record a step‑adjacency matrix for constructing the final graph script.
answer_1.outputs: Generated step sequences (imperative instructions) and graph scripts (step‑adjacency matrices).

answer_2.quote: our best model achieves 17.52% absolute gains in overall F1@3 for next step prediction and 13.8% absolute gains on Accuracy@1 for partial sequence completion. ... we also report normalized edit distance.

answer_4.quote: we use MTurk to perform Human Evaluation on the correctness and expressiveness of our auto‑generated graph scripts. ... we design T/F questions regarding sequential, optional, and interchangeable relations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer true/false questions about whether step relations (sequential, optional, interchangeable) are appropriate for the generated graph script.
